status: research-only; no dependency selection or installation approval
method: Fetched the exact npm version metadata and tarball over HTTPS, compared the tarball bytes to the registry dist.integrity SHA-512 SRI value, parsed package metadata and read selected notice/source files in memory. No package was extracted to disk, installed or executed.
limitations: The SRI value and tarball are obtained from the same registry; a match is not independent publisher authentication, build provenance or source-to-binary attestation.
This review covers only four exact direct-candidate tarballs; it does not review their transitive, optional, bundled or build dependency closure.
License declarations and embedded notice files are evidence for follow-up, not a legal compatibility or redistribution decision.
Static presence of a native binary does not establish ABI compatibility, runtime behavior, security or support on the selected ARM64 guest and target.
